Fingerprint.description:
What a stage file was made from.

Attributes:
    inputs: SHA-256 of the content of every input file, by input name.
    settings: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the settings the stage declares.
    stage_version: The version of the stage's own code.
Fingerprint.title: Fingerprint

description:
``render.json``: what the render stage made.

Attributes:
    preset: The output preset that was used.
    audio_encoder: ``fdkaac`` or ``ffmpeg-aac``.
    files: The names of the files in the output folder: the MP4, the audio export if any, and
        the enhanced LRC.
    fonts: The faces libass drew with; all of them the bundled font.
    seconds: How long the renderer took.
title: RenderFile
